title: DataConsistency
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Consistency inherent data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that are free from contradiction and are coherent with other data in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent Data Quality — Consistency).

consistencyLevel.description: Required consistency guarantee. INCONSISTENT = no guarantee. EVENTUALLY_CONSISTENT = converges over time. STRONGLY_CONSISTENT = immediate within system boundary. FULLY_CONSISTENT = across all systems and replicas.

crossReferenceIntegrity.description: Whether referential integrity must be enforced across related data entities.

conflictResolutionStrategy.description: Strategy for resolving data conflicts when inconsistencies are detected.
